answer: Because the timing is logged against the raven challenge, the voyage audit can replay the relic history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 21 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4877 identities would post 4394 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
